_note: A getGeoAttributes response in the shape the live portal returns, with every value replaced by a synthetic one. The nearBy entry deliberately carries the identifying fields the real server sends — requerente, email, criador_id, logedUser, local — so PrivacyTests can prove none of them survive parsing. The names use .invalid, which is reserved by RFC 2606.
_note_type: This is the answer to ocoTipo=262, so every nearBy row is type 262. The portal scopes nearBy to the type asked for — 89 of 89 rows in the captured session were the type requested — and a fixture carrying a second type would depict a response the server does not produce. Checking another type costs another request; see Geo.nearBy(tipoIds:).
_note_rows: One row per outcome of the duplicate filter, each excluded for exactly one reason: OCO/00000 is open and 20 m away, so it is the duplicate; OCO/00001 is open but 141 m away, excluded on distance alone; OCO/00002 is 14 m away but resolved, excluded on state alone.
